observations: Photo shows two DualShock-style controllers on top of a console box.
The box has visible text 'PS4' and 'STAR WARS' branding.
No clear view of the console itself (no front/back ports, no model label, no serial/model sticker).
No visible PS4 Pro-specific markings (e.g., 'Pro' on the console) in the photo.
Power/AV cables are visible, but the photo does not show them connected to a working console.

claims.evidence: Photo shows PS4/Star Wars box and controllers, but the console model ('Pro') is not readable and the console itself is not shown.
Performance claims cannot be verified from the photo.

risks.risk: It may be a standard PS4 (not Pro), or the listing may be mismatched to the actual console model.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console label/sticker showing the exact model (CUH-7xxx for Pro) and a photo of the console front/back ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-Pro PS4 bundle (worst case vs 'Pro').

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have faults (disc drive issues, overheating, HDMI/power problems).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the console powering on and reaching the home screen, plus a quick game/app launch.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / untested until proven.

risks.risk: Controllers may have drift, dead buttons, or poor charging.
risks.proof: A video showing controller inputs working in-game/menu and charging/charging indicator (or a quick test in the PS4 settings).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming controllers may need repair/replacement.

risks.risk: Bundle completeness is unclear (which cables, whether original DualShock, whether any games are included).
risks.proof: A laid-out photo listing every item included (console, both controllers, power cable, HDMI cable, any game discs, headset, etc.).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console + controllers only, with missing/uncertain accessories treated as not included.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console itself (front + back ports) and the model sticker/label (CUH code) to confirm PS4 Pro.
Short video: power on → home screen loads successfully.
Video or photos confirming both controllers work (no drift) and charging works.
Photo of the full bundle laid out (all cables and any games/discs included).
response.reason: The photo shows PS4/Star Wars packaging and controllers, but it does not clearly show the console model or confirm it is a PS4 Pro, nor does it prove the console/controllers work. Missing decisive proof prevents safe pricing.
